Rashi on Yevamot 52b:10:1.hebrew: כעודר - חופר. וכסבור שלו הן — שהיה קרקע הגר סמוך לקרקעו, ומת הגר ואין לו יורשין, והמחזיק בנכסיו קנה; וזה חופר בקרקע הגר וכסבור שזה קרקע שלו, ולא נתכוון להחזיק, דלא קני. והאי נמי סבור שקידושי יבמה תופסין בה, ולא נתכוון לקנות אלא מכח ייבומי אחיו, והא פקעו להו:
Rashi on Yevamot 52b:10:1.english: Like one who hoes - Digging. And [as for] "thinking that it is his own" — [the case is] that the convert's land was adjacent to his own land, and the convert died without heirs, and whoever takes possession of his property acquires [it]; and this [person] digs in the convert's land thinking that this is his own land, and he did not intend to take possession, so he does not acquire [it]. And this [man] too thinks that betrothal of a yevamah takes effect on her, and he intended to acquire [her] only by virtue of his brother's levirate bond, and behold, it has already ceased.

Rashi on Yevamot 52b:11:1.english: There, he does not intend to acquire - For he thinks [the property is] his.

Rashi on Yevamot 52b:11:2.english: Here he intends to acquire - In any case.

Rashi on Yevamot 52b:11:3.english: This is not comparable, etc. - It is Abaye who continues raising [this] objection.

Rashi on Yevamot 52b:11:4.hebrew: וכסבור של גר אחר הוא - ומתכוון לקנות מכל מקום. והאי נמי קסבר לקנות מכח אחיו, ואינו קונה אלא מכחו, ומ"מ קנין הוא:
Rashi on Yevamot 52b:11:4.english: And while thinking it is that of a different convert - And he intends to acquire [it] in any case. And this [man] too thinks [he is] acquiring [her] by virtue of his brother, whereas he acquires [her] only by virtue of himself, and in any case it is an acquisition.

Rashi on Yevamot 52b:12:1.hebrew: מאמר עילוי זיקה רמי - מאמר דתקינו רבנן לכל היבמין, לא תקון אלא היכא דקיימא זיקה ואתא מאמר ואיתוסף עלה. והכא ליכא למימר הכי, דאתיא חליצה מפקעה לזיקה:
Rashi on Yevamot 52b:12:1.english: Levirate betrothal is superimposed upon the levirate bond - Levirate betrothal that the Rabbis enacted for all levirs, they only enacted [it] where the levirate bond stands, and levirate betrothal comes and is added onto it. Here, however, one cannot say so, for ḥalitza comes [and] cancels the levirate bond.

Rashi on Yevamot 52b:12:2.hebrew: האי לחודיה קאי כו' - ולא מהני זיקה למאמר, הילכך השתא כמעיקרא. מעיקרא, אילו אמר לה "התקדשי לי במאמר יבמין", מי לא קני, ואף על גב דלא מהניא ליה זיקה, דהאי לחודה קיימא? השתא נמי מהני:
Rashi on Yevamot 52b:12:2.english: This stands on its own, etc. - And the levirate bond does not avail for ma'amar; therefore, now [after chalitzah] is like originally. Originally, if he had said to her, "Be betrothed to me with levirate ma'amar," would it not acquire [her], even though the levirate bond does not avail it, since this [bond] stands on its own? Now too, it is effective.

Rashi on Yevamot 52b:1:1.hebrew: ולאשה בעלמא - וכנסה וגירשה בו, אינו גט, הואיל כשנכתב לא היה ראוי לגירושין:
Rashi on Yevamot 52b:1:1.english: And for an ordinary woman - And he married her and divorced her with it, it is not a [valid] bill of divorce, since when it was written it was not fit for divorce.

Rashi on Yevamot 52b:1:2.hebrew: ליבמתו מהו - כתבו קודם שכנסה, וכשכנסה נתנו לה, מהו שתתגרש בו:
Rashi on Yevamot 52b:1:2.english: For his yevama, what is [the law] - [If] he wrote it before he married her, and when he married her he gave it to her, what is [the law] as to whether she is divorced with it?

Rashi on Yevamot 52b:2:1.hebrew: כתב גט לזיקתו ולא למאמרו או למאמרו ולא לזיקתו - והוא עשה בה מאמר תחלה, מהו שתיפסל עליו בכך:
Rashi on Yevamot 52b:2:1.english: [If] he wrote a bill of divorce for his levirate bond and not for his levirate betrothal, or for his levirate betrothal and not for his levirate bond - where he had performed levirate betrothal with her first, what is [the law] as to whether she becomes disqualified to him thereby?

Rashi on Yevamot 52b:2:2.hebrew: מאמר עילוי זיקה רמי - כשעשה מאמר, נדבק עם הזיקה וניתוסף עליה, ואין גט מועיל לזה בלא זה. וכיון שנכתב בתוך הגט שלא עשאו אלא לאחד מהן, הוה ליה מגרש חצי אשה, ולא כלום היא ומותרת לו:
Rashi on Yevamot 52b:2:2.english: Levirate betrothal is superimposed upon [the] levirate bond - When he performed levirate betrothal, [it] became attached to the levirate bond and was added onto it, and a bill of divorce is not effective for this without that. And since it was written inside the bill of divorce that he only made it for one of them, he is [like] one who divorces half a woman, and it is nothing, and she is permitted to him.

Rashi on Yevamot 52b:2:3.hebrew: או דלמא האי לחודיה קאי והאי לחודיה קאי - ומהני. והיכא דכתב לזיקתו ולא למאמרו, אסורה עליו ועל אחיו, דפקע זיקה וקמה ב"לא יבנה". ואי כתב למאמרו ולא לזיקתו, אסורה לו ומותרת לאחיו, דמאמר דעבד שקליה, ופשה ליה זיקה כמעיקרא:
Rashi on Yevamot 52b:2:3.english: Or perhaps this stands on its own and that stands on its own - And [the bill of divorce] is effective. And where he wrote [it] for his levirate bond and not for his levirate betrothal, she is forbidden to him and to his brothers, for the levirate bond is severed and she stands under [the prohibition of] "he shall not rebuild [his brother's house]." And if he wrote [it] for his levirate betrothal and not for his levirate bond, she is forbidden to him and permitted to his brothers, for the levirate betrothal that he performed, he has removed, and the levirate bond remains for him as it was originally.

Rashi on Yevamot 52b:3:1.hebrew: נתן גט למאמרו - ולא לזיקתו. בארבעה אחין (לעיל יבמות לב.), גבי זיקת [ב] יבמין: ג' אחין נשואין ג' נכריות, ומת אחד מהן, ועשה בה השני מאמר ומת — הרי אלו חולצות כו'. וקאמר רבא עלה: נתן גט למאמרו ואח"כ מת, הותרה אשתו הראשונה, שהיא צרתה, לאחיו השני; דאי לאו גט, הוה אסורה עליו משום זיקת שני יבמין. אלמא האי לחודיה קאי, מדאהני גט לאישתרויי צרתה לאחיו השני. והוא הדין דהיא גופה נמי שריא לאחיו, אלא דמחלפא בבעלת גט גמור לזיקה דמקמי מאמר, או לזיקה ומאמר. והכי אמרינן בארבעה אחין:
Rashi on Yevamot 52b:3:1.english: He gave a bill of divorce for his ma'amar [levirate betrothal] - and not for his zikah [levirate bond]. In [the chapter] Arba'ah Achim (above, Yevamot 32a), regarding the zikah of two yevamin: [The Mishnah states:] Three brothers married to three unrelated women, and one of them died, and the second [brother] performed ma'amar with her and died — these perform chalitzah, etc. And Rava said regarding it: If he gave a bill of divorce for his ma'amar and afterward died, his first wife — who is her rival wife — is permitted to his other brother; for were it not for the bill of divorce, she would be forbidden to him because of the zikah of two yevamin. Apparently, this [ma'amar] stands on its own, since the bill of divorce was effective to permit her rival wife to his other brother. And the same applies that she herself is also permitted to his brother, except that she might be confused with a woman who received a complete bill of divorce for the zikah [that existed] prior to ma'amar, or for [both] zikah and ma'amar. And so we say in Arba'ah Achim.

Rashi on Yevamot 52b:4:1.hebrew: זו דברי רבי עקיבא - אחלץ ועשה בה מאמר קאי, דקתני לא תפיס מאמר:
Rashi on Yevamot 52b:4:1.english: This is the statement of Rabbi Akiva - [This] refers to "[If] he performed chalitzah and performed ma'amar with her," where [the Mishnah] teaches [that] ma'amar [levirate betrothal] does not take effect.

Rashi on Yevamot 52b:6:1.hebrew: אחר שילוח - כלומר, מדכתיב "אשר שלחה" קרא יתירא דלא צריך, הכי קאמר: יש לך משלח שאסור להחזיר אחר שילוח אפילו לא נישאת, ואיזו? זו יבמה. וכיון דבלאו קאי, היכי מהני בה תו מאמר:
Rashi on Yevamot 52b:6:1.english: After sending [her] away - That is to say, since it is written, “who sent her away” — [which is] a superfluous verse that is not needed — this is what it means: there is [a case of] one who sends [his wife] away who is forbidden to take [her] back after sending [her] away, even if she has not married [another man]. And who is this? This is a yevama. And since he is subject to a negative prohibition, how can ma'amar [levirate betrothal] still be effective for her?

Rashi on Yevamot 52b:8:1.english: When - does betrothal take effect after ḥalitza?

Rashi on Yevamot 52b:8:2.hebrew: בזמן שקדשה לשום אישות - בקידושין גמורים ולא במאמר יבמין, דודאי קידושין תופסין בחייבי לאוין:
Rashi on Yevamot 52b:8:2.english: When he betrothed her for the purpose of marriage - [That is,] with a full betrothal and not with a levirate declaration [ma'amar], for betrothal certainly takes effect with [those prohibited by] negative commandments.

Rashi on Yevamot 52b:8:3.hebrew: אבל קדשה לשום יבמות - אינן קידושין, שהרי אין כאן צד ייבום, והוו להו קידושי טעות:
Rashi on Yevamot 52b:8:3.english: But [if] he betrothed her for the sake of levirate marriage - It is not [a valid] betrothal, for there is no aspect of levirate marriage here, and it is a mistaken betrothal.

Tosafot on Yevamot 52b:10:1.hebrew: כעודר בנכסי הגר - אר"י דמיירי לרב יוסף כגון דאמר לה "התקדשי לי" סתם, ו"לשם יבמות" היינו דגלי אדעתיה שבתורת יבמין מקדשה; דאי באמר לה בהדיא "במאמר יבמין", לא הוי פריך ליה אביי "מי דמי?", דהא אביי קאמר בסמוך דהיכא דאמר לה "במאמר יבמין", דלא קני לרבי. אלא בסתם איירי, א"נ באמר לה "התקדשי לי לשם יבמות", ולא משמע בתורת מאמר יבמין; ד"במאמר יבמין" משמע בתורת מאמר ולא בתורת קידושין, אבל "לשם יבמות" לא משמע בתורת יבמות, אלא שסבור שעדיין היא זקוקתו:
Tosafot on Yevamot 52b:10:1.english: Like one who hoes the property of a convert - Rabbi Yitzchak says that according to Rav Yosef, [the baraita] is speaking of a case where he said to her, "Be betrothed to me," without specification, and [what it calls] "for the purpose of levirate marriage" means that he revealed his intention that he is betrothing her by way of levirate marriage; for if [it were speaking] of a case where he explicitly said to her "with levirate betrothal," Abaye would not have objected to him, "Are they comparable?" — since Abaye [himself] says shortly [hereafter] that where he said to her "with levirate betrothal," he does not acquire [her] according to Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi]. Rather, [Rav Yosef] is speaking of [an] unspecified [betrothal]; or alternatively, of [a case] where he said to her, "Be betrothed to me for the purpose of levirate marriage," and it does not imply [acting] by way of levirate betrothal; for "with levirate betrothal" implies [acting] by way of levirate betrothal (ma'amar) and not by way of [ordinary] betrothal (kiddushin), whereas "for the purpose of levirate marriage" does not imply [acting] by way of levirate marriage, but rather [indicates] that he thinks she is still bound to him [by the levirate bond].

Tosafot on Yevamot 52b:12:1.hebrew: אי אמר לה התקדשי לי בזיקת מאמר יבמין מי לא מהני - דאפילו למ"ד אין זיקה, היינו לענין אחות זקוקתו וכיוצא בה; אבל פשיטא דמהני לשון זיקה, שהרי היא זקוקתו ועומדת בפניו:
Tosafot on Yevamot 52b:12:1.english: If he said to her: "Be betrothed to me with the levirate bond of levirate betrothal," would it not be effective? - For even according to the one who says there is no levirate bond [zikah], that is [only] with respect to the sister of a woman bound to him [by a levirate bond] and the like; but it is obvious that the language of a levirate bond is effective, since she is indeed bound to him and standing before him.

Tosafot on Yevamot 52b:1:1.hebrew: ולאשה בעלמא אין גט - ואפילו כתוב בו זמן דאחר נשואים, כיון דאין בידו לגרשה בשעה שעשאו שליח. ונראה לר"י דהיינו דוקא למ"ד אין אדם מקנה דבר שלא בא לעולם, אבל למאן דאמר אדם מקנה — הוי גט, דבידו לגרשה, כמו בשחרור, דמהני לוקח עבד על מנת לשחררו וכתב לו: "לכשאקחך הרי עצמך קנוי לך מעכשיו", כדאמר בהאשה רבה (לקמן יבמות דף צג:) ובקידושין בפרק האומר (דף סג.); וגט שחרור וגט אשה שוים לכל דבר, דהא ילפינן "לה" "לה" מאשה:
Tosafot on Yevamot 52b:1:1.english: And for a regular woman, it is not a [valid] get - Even if a date from after marriage is written in it, since it is not in his power to divorce her at the time he appointed him [as] an agent. And it appears to the Ri that this is specifically according to the one who says a person cannot transfer something that has not [yet] come into the world, but according to the one who says a person can transfer [something that has not yet come into the world] — it is a [valid] get, since it is in his power to divorce her, just like with emancipation [of a slave], where it is effective [when] one buys a slave on condition to emancipate him and writes to him: "When I buy you, behold, you yourself are acquired to yourself from now," as it says in [the chapter] Ha'isha Rabbah (below, Yevamot 93b) and in Kiddushin in the chapter Ha'omer (63a); and a bill of emancipation and a woman's get are equal in every respect, for we derive [this via the gezerah shavah of] "to her" [and] "to her" from a woman:

Tosafot on Yevamot 52b:1:2.hebrew: ליבמתו מהו - אין לפרש דמיבעיא ליה אם גירשה בגט זה לאחר שיבמה יבומין גמורין, אי הוי גט אי לא; דפשיטא דאין ניתרת בגט זה לשוק, דהא בההיא שעתא לא היה בידו לגרשה ולהתירה לשוק על ידי גט זה. ומאי קאמר נמי: "או דלמא כיון דלא עבד בה מאמר — לא"? אי בלא מאמר לא מהני, עבד בה מאמר נמי לא מהני להתגרש אחר שתתייבם, דמאמר לא הוי אלא מדרבנן. ואמר ר"י דלפוסלה מכהונה מיבעיא ליה: אי חשיב ריח הגט דפסיל לכהונה, אי לא. וריב"ם הגיה בפירושיו דמיבעיא ליה: אי כתבו קודם מאמר, ועשה מאמר, וגירש בו — מהו שיפקיע את מאמר:
Tosafot on Yevamot 52b:1:2.english: "[If he wrote a bill of divorce] for his yevama, what is [the halakha]?" - One should not explain that [Rami bar Ḥama] is inquiring about [a case where] he divorced her with this bill of divorce after he performed full levirate marriage (yibum) with her, [asking] whether it is a [valid] bill of divorce or not; for it is obvious that she is not permitted [to marry] into the general public by this bill of divorce, since at that time [when it was written] it was not in his power to divorce her and permit her to the general public by means of this bill of divorce. Furthermore, what does [the Gemara] mean [by saying]: "Or perhaps, since he did not perform ma'amar (levirate betrothal) with her — no"? If without ma'amar it is not effective, [even if] he had performed ma'amar with her it would also not be effective to divorce her after she undergoes yibum, since ma'amar is only by rabbinic law. Rather, the Ri says that [the Gemara] is inquiring with regard to disqualifying her from [marrying into] the priesthood: whether it is considered [to have] the "scent of a bill of divorce" (reiach haget) that disqualifies [her] from the priesthood, or not. And Rivam emended [it] in his commentary, [explaining] that [the Gemara] is inquiring: if he wrote it before ma'amar, and [then] performed ma'amar, and divorced [her] with it — what is [the law regarding] whether it uproots the ma'amar.

Tosafot on Yevamot 52b:2:1.hebrew: או דלמא האי לחודיה קאי כו' - פירש בקונטרס: "ואי כתב גט למאמרו ולא לזיקתו — אסורה לו ומותרת לאחיו, דמאמר דעבד ליה שקליה, ופשה ליה זיקה כמעיקרא". ולר"י נראה, דללישנא דאמר רבא הותרה אפילו היא — ואם כן הכא נמי שריא לדידיה; וללישנא דהיא אסורה דמיחלפא בבעלת הגט — הכא נמי אסורה אפי' לאחיו, דהא בעלת הגט אסורה על כל האחין. והא דשרי רבא צרתה בנתן גט למאמרו — משום דבאות משני בתים הן, ואפילו היה נותן גט גם לזיקתו היתה צרתה מותרת:
Tosafot on Yevamot 52b:2:1.english: Or perhaps this stands on its own, etc. - Rashi explained: "And if he wrote a bill of divorce for his levirate betrothal and not for his levirate bond, she is forbidden to him and permitted to his brothers, for he has removed the levirate betrothal that he performed with her, and the levirate bond remains as it was originally." But it appears to Rabbi Yitzḥak [Ri] that according to the version in which Rava says [she] is permitted, even she [herself is permitted] — and if so, here too she is permitted to him; and according to the version that she is forbidden because she might be confused with a woman who received a bill of divorce [for her levirate bond] — here too she is forbidden even to his brothers, since a woman who received a bill of divorce is forbidden to all the brothers. And [the reason] that Rava permits her rival wife when he gave a bill of divorce for his levirate betrothal is because they come from two [different] houses, and even if he had given a bill of divorce for his levirate bond as well, her rival wife would be permitted.
